Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3467 and H4994); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration:--hosanna.
BiblicalUsage: hōsanná is a plain word for hosanna, oh save!. In Matthew 21:9, the text says "Hosanna to the Son of David." In Matthew 21:15, the text says "Hosanna to the Son of David."
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: hōsanná tells me that praise is the right answer to who God is, and it is never wasted. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Triumphal Entry; The Cleansing of the Temple
